questions.question: Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in the 853rd race than the next race for the fastest lap speed?

questions.question: Please list the account types that are not eligible for loans, and the average income of residents in the district where the account is located exceeds $8000 but is no more than $9000.
questions.evidence: A11 represents the average salary; Salary and income share the similar meanings; when the account type = 'OWNER', it's eligible for loans
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.type FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type != 'OWNER' AND T1.A11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

questions.question: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
questions.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last name; spent money for refers expense description; expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T1.cost FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost FROM member AS m INNER JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

questions.question: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?
questions.evidence: TR060 is the molecule id;
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR060'
